title: How the shepherd keeps the wolf away

plan.english: Shepherd, how do you protect the flock from wolves? At night I do not rest; I sit on the hill and keep awake. And when the wolf comes, what do you do? I cry out, and I throw stones at him. Is the wolf not stronger than you? He is stronger; I am wiser. Will you be a shepherd? I will be a shepherd, and I will not tremble before the wolf.

title: Why the dog does not speak

plan.english: Old man, why does the dog not speak? Men received words, and beasts received tails. How does he speak with his tail? When he is glad, his tail turns; when he is afraid, he hides it. Then I know his tongue! Listen to him, and he will listen to you.
